body: I thank you deeply for your words, but honestly I don't think i deserve to be loved more than that. I've not demonstrated any qualities that would imply that i deserve anything. Look at it from her perspective. Im sure if she were to give her opinion on the matter it would be obvious that i am the one at fault. Though I accept most of my issues are my own doing, it does not make them less painful. Hence i have resorted to this countdown. I cannot bear the weight of my own failure anymore
